question: What interface[] term should represent an email mailbox that offers no programmatic mailbox protocol (IMAP, POP, JMAP), and terms for IMAP, POP, SMTP and JMAP themselves? Zoho Mail Free is webmail and mobile-app only with IMAP, POP and Active Sync not included; smtp.zoho.com is documented for personal and free organization users; a Zoho Mail REST API exists but its availability is set by plan and permissions; no first-party JMAP documentation was found.
why: The interface[] vocabulary has no term for an email retrieval protocol or for a service with no programmatic interface; $.interface was kept as ['unknown'] and the protocol findings are recorded in $.interface_detail.
